notes.title: Our next game!
notes.content:
We can announce our next game!

Security: The Horrible Nights
Wishlist:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2911390/Security_The_Horrible_Nights/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2911390/Security_The_Horrible_Nights/[/url]

We've taken it a step further with the feature that something changes when you die. "Every time you die, a new story begins."

You work as a security guard at a hospital where all sorts of mysterious and scary things can happen. Your job is to use the hospital's security cameras to monitor the area. When you see a problem, you have to run out and fix it. Most often, the problem can be solved by pointing your flashlight at it and shouting at the problem. Other times, you'll need to use more drastic methods to solve problems, or just survive.

We look forward to killing you again.
- John & Maria

notes.title: One last half-big update
notes.content:
One last half-big update before we have to move on to the next game project.

[b]You can reset your game[/b]

Under the game’s option, you can now reset the game at any point. Your fishy achievements will not be deleted.

[b]Fixed bugs and small improvements[/b]

Some of you have been good at finding strange and weird bugs. The ones we could recreate have been fixed. We have also done a few small improvements. So new and old players should get a slightly better experience now. Thanks for the help.

[b]New language[/b]

The game can now also be played in Danish, which is our mother tongue. Apart from the fact that it is fun to have your own game in your own language, it was also a requirement we had to fulfill from the art fund that has supported the project. Thanks again to the Danish Film Institute for helping make Anglerfish a reality.

[b]Starting work on a new game[/b]

We have already started our next project. We are not yet ready to reveal what we are working on. But should you be curious, you can follow us on Discord and Twitter.

[b]Discord[/b]
[url=https://discord.gg/vNn542vjhX]https://discord.gg/vNn542vjhX[/url]

[b]Twitter[/b]
@prof_villains

[b]A big thanks![/b]

We have tried to thank each of you personally who have helped make this project become real. If we have forgotten someone along the way, it is not intentional. We are only three people on the main team, so it is only through all your helping hands that Anglerfish has become what we hoped it could be.

Thank you.
John, Maria and Astrid

notes.title: Are you ready for the true ending and much more?!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41397057/713beb69cb4e009b5e7d40561fb8eb902e264ce4.png[/img]

[b]What is in the update?[/b]

Anglerfish part 2 is out now and it’s free. This update includes a new ending for playthrough 1, as well as a new playthrough mode that is a new take on the entire game. There are big new changes in playthrough 2, which also has its very own ending. It should be a very refreshing Anglerfish experience.

If you have already completed Anglerfish, the game will automatically start with the new ending for playthrough 1. The game will use some data from your first playthrough in your playthrough 2.

With this update, Anglerfish has become approx. twice as big as it was previously. We are a very small team and there are many parts of Anglerfish that can be very different depending on how you play. So even though we try to playtest a lot, we can have overlooked some bugs. If you find one, report it in the bug thread and we will look into it as soon as possible.

[b]How you influenced all the new things in Anglerfish[/b]

We have been watching your videos and reading your reviews and comments. This has inspired us to do more things in this new update than originally planned. Therefore, you who have been involved from the beginning have influence Anglerfish a lot.

Steam reviews are the game's "guest book". Reading from several of you that you have had exactly the experience we hoped we could give you gives us a lot of energy to continue our work with Anglerfish. This is a passion project, so every single review where someone who enjoyed our game talks about their experience, or just that you have enjoyed the game is nice for us to read. You are one of the big reasons we are making this strange game.

Thanks to all of you who have shared the game with others. It is appreciated.

[b]The future of Anglerfish[/b]

We are already well underway with a bonus part 3 that will include a new playthrough mode with two new endings. The plan is to have this finished by January 19, 2023. Those who complete playthroughs 1 & 2 before the new update will get a little extra surprise!

We look forward to hearing about your experiences with this new major update.
- John & Maria
Professional Villains

notes.title: The release date is not the end station for Anglerfish.
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41397057/713beb69cb4e009b5e7d40561fb8eb902e264ce4.png[/img]

The release date is not the end station for Anglerfish. Over the next 10 weeks we will release a second and third playthrough mode. Each of these new playthrough modes will be a new take on the game. They will be significantly different experiences than your first playthrough of the game and each other. They will both be free updates.

Those of you who beat Anglerfish before playthrough 2 mode comes out will be reward with a little surprise. If you beat playthrough 2 mode before playthrough 3 mode comes out then another little surprise awaits you.

We would also love to make a free DLC where you play as the blonde vampire you find in the game. But for that to be possible, we need to sell more than 5000 copies of Anglerfish before the 19th of January 2023. If you want to help make this DLC become a reality, then buy your copy of Anglerfish now, spread the word about the game and write a Steam review. It all helps and we appreciate it.

We would like to thank all of you who have already helped in one way or another to create Anglerfish. We will have half a glass of champagne and otherwise continue our work with Anglerfish.

Sincerely.
- John & Maria
